qc.label: Medium
checklist: Can your dark stores achieve positive unit economics where each order covers its own delivery labor?
Do you have 12+ months of cash runway remaining without relying on immediate new fundraising?
Are your daily inventory holding and operational expenses strictly controlled to prevent excessive cash burn?
Is your customer order frequency high enough to cover the high overhead of instant delivery infrastructure?
Do you have sufficient capital and scale to defend your market share against massive, well-funded competitors?

fd.label: High
checklist: Do you have 12+ months of cash runway without securing new funding?
Can you profitably fulfill every single delivery order today?
Are your logistics costs staying below 20 percent of your average order value?
Do you have a clear feature or pricing advantage against well-funded giants?
